prompt: Which compute type gives you the most control over the operating system?
explanation: With VMs you choose and manage the operating system.

why_wrong.d: Containers share the host operating system.
why_wrong.c: App Service manages the operating system for you.

prompt: Which Azure option runs small pieces of code in response to events and bills per execution?
explanation: Azure Functions is serverless and event-driven.

why_wrong.c: VMs run continuously and you manage them.
why_wrong.d: Azure Virtual Desktop hosts desktops, not event-driven code.
why_wrong.a: An availability set is a way to group VMs, not a compute service.

prompt: A team wants to package an app with its dependencies so it runs the same on a laptop and in Azure, starts quickly and shares the host operating system. What should it use?
explanation: Containers are lightweight, portable and share the host operating system.

why_wrong.d: Each VM includes its own full operating system.
why_wrong.a: Azure Virtual Desktop delivers desktops to users.
why_wrong.c: An availability set does not package applications.

prompt: Which Azure feature creates and manages a group of identical, load-balanced virtual machines that can autoscale?
explanation: Scale sets manage identical VMs and can scale out and in automatically.

why_wrong.b: Availability sets spread VMs across fault and update domains but do not autoscale.
why_wrong.d: Azure Virtual Desktop hosts user desktops.
why_wrong.c: Azure Functions runs event-driven code, not groups of VMs.

prompt: What do availability sets protect against?

options.text: Hardware failures and planned maintenance within a datacenter
The loss of an entire region
The loss of an entire datacenter

explanation: Availability sets spread VMs across fault domains and update domains inside one datacenter.

why_wrong.b: Region failures need resources in other regions.
why_wrong.d: An availability set sits within one datacenter; availability zones protect against datacenter loss.
why_wrong.c: Network speed for users is unrelated.

prompt: A company wants employees to use a Windows desktop and apps hosted in Azure from any device. Which service fits?
explanation: Azure Virtual Desktop delivers cloud-hosted Windows desktops and apps.

why_wrong.b: Scale sets autoscale identical VMs for workloads, not user desktops.
why_wrong.d: Container Instances runs containers, not user desktops.

prompt: Which resource connects a virtual machine to a virtual network?
explanation: A network interface attaches the VM to a subnet in a virtual network.

why_wrong.b: Locks prevent accidental deletion or change.
why_wrong.d: Tags are labels used for organising and cost tracking.

prompt: A company wants to host a web application without managing servers or the operating system. Which option fits best?
explanation: App Service is a PaaS offering for web apps and APIs.

why_wrong.a: With VMs you manage the operating system.
why_wrong.c: An availability set only groups VMs.
why_wrong.d: Azure Virtual Desktop delivers desktops, not web hosting.

prompt: Which TWO resources does a virtual machine typically need? (Select two.)

options.text: A management group dedicated to the VM
A disk that holds the operating system
A network interface connected to a virtual network

explanation: A VM needs storage for its operating system and a network connection, along with a size and image.

why_wrong.a: Management groups are optional organisation tools.
why_wrong.d: Policy assignments are optional governance tools.
why_wrong.e: A SaaS licence is not a VM requirement.

prompt: Which TWO are benefits of containers compared with virtual machines? (Select two.)

options.text: They give the most control over operating system settings
They remove the need for any host
Each container includes its own full operating system
They are lightweight and start quickly

explanation: Containers share the host operating system, so they are light, fast and portable.

why_wrong.d: Containers share the host kernel instead of including a full operating system.
why_wrong.b: VMs give more control over the operating system.
why_wrong.c: Containers still run on a host.

prompt: Decide whether each statement is true.

options.text: Azure Functions is an example of serverless compute.
An availability set can protect VMs from the failure of an entire region.
Azure Virtual Desktop provides cloud-hosted Windows desktops.

explanation: Functions is serverless and AVD hosts desktops; availability sets work inside one datacenter.

why_wrong.s1: Yes. You do not manage servers.
why_wrong.s2: No. It works within one datacenter.

prompt: Decide whether each statement is true.

options.text: Virtual machines are an IaaS compute option.
Azure App Service lets you host web apps without managing the underlying servers.
The VMs in a scale set are all configured differently.

explanation: VMs are IaaS and App Service is PaaS; scale sets contain identical VMs.

why_wrong.s1: Yes. You manage the operating system.
why_wrong.s3: No. A scale set is a group of identical VMs.

prompt: A team wants to add speech and vision features to an app through APIs without training its own models. Which category fits?
explanation: Azure AI services provide prebuilt capabilities through APIs.

why_wrong.d: Machine Learning is for building and training custom models.

prompt: A data science team needs to build, train and manage its own custom machine learning models. Which service fits?
explanation: Azure Machine Learning supports custom model development and management.

why_wrong.c: IoT Central is for connected-device solutions.

prompt: Which service provides secure two-way communication between cloud services and IoT devices?
explanation: IoT Hub connects devices and cloud services in both directions.

why_wrong.c: IoT Edge runs workloads on devices near the data.
why_wrong.a: Azure OpenAI Service supports generative AI.

prompt: What does Azure IoT Edge do?

options.text: Extends cloud capabilities to edge devices so some workloads run closer to where data is produced

explanation: IoT Edge brings workloads close to the devices that generate data.

why_wrong.b: Billing is handled in Cost Management and Billing.

prompt: Decide whether each statement is true.

options.text: Azure OpenAI Service supports generative AI scenarios such as chat and content generation.
Azure IoT Central is a software-as-a-service IoT platform that simplifies solution management.
Azure Machine Learning provides only prebuilt AI features and cannot be used to train custom models.

explanation: OpenAI Service covers generative AI and IoT Central simplifies IoT solutions, while Machine Learning is for custom models.

why_wrong.s1: Yes. Chat and content generation are typical scenarios.
why_wrong.s2: Yes. It is a simplified SaaS platform.
why_wrong.s3: No. Machine Learning is for building and training custom models.
